focus: Chicago suburbs: Franklin Park (O’Hare), Villa Park, Glen Ellyn, St. Charles, Plainfield, East Dundee, Cary, Lakemoor, and Winthrop Harbor
intro: These Chicago listings were checked on operator-owned pages on November 22, 2026. Chicago is the third-largest U.S. metro and the start of Route 66, but there is no big RV depot downtown, so every pickup here is in the suburbs: Cruise America runs six depots from Franklin Park near O’Hare out to East Dundee, Lakemoor, St. Charles, Plainfield, and Winthrop Harbor; El Monte RV and Art’s RV share a Glen Ellyn address; Indie Campers is in Villa Park; and RV Rent N Go is in Cary. Winter hours are short and most depots close Sunday (El Monte is closed all weekend), so check the day before you plan a weekend trip. Hours and flags are copied only from those pages. This is a starting sample, not a metro-wide inventory, and it does not cache live RV availability. Peer-to-peer platforms such as RVshare and Outdoorsy show live inventory for a specific weekend. If a price appears, it is labeled as listed on a date.

listings.name: El Monte RV — Chicago (Glen Ellyn)
listings.area: Glen Ellyn, on North Ave (IL-64) in DuPage County; about 20 miles from O’Hare per the operator

hours.notes: Current season (Oct 1–Mar 31) per the official Chicago page: Mon–Fri 9:00 AM–4:00 PM, Saturday and Sunday closed. Apr 1–Sep 30: Mon–Fri 9:00 AM–5:00 PM, Saturday and Sunday closed. The page lists holiday closures, including Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day. Pickup is listed as after 1:00 PM on weekdays and drop-off as before 10:00 AM; the page says after-hours pickups are not possible.

listings.offersNotes: El Monte RV’s official one-way page lists Chicago among its locations and suggests a Route 66 itinerary from Chicago to Los Angeles. It says one-way rentals are often possible but may carry a surcharge. Confirm the route and any fee when you book.
listings.feeNotes: The official Chicago page lists a $1,500 security deposit due at pickup and a $50 fee for each extra hour after your scheduled drop-off time, as listed on November 22, 2026.
listings.visitNotes: The depot shares its North Ave address and branch phone with Art’s RV Sales & Service, whose site lists the El Monte rental office separately. You pick pickup and drop-off time slots during online self check-in, which opens 30 days before arrival. The page says parking for your own car varies by location, so call ahead. Closed on weekends year-round, so this is not a Saturday-pickup option.

listings.name: Indie Campers — Chicago (Villa Park)
listings.area: Villa Park, in the western suburbs (DuPage County)
listings.address: 740 N Princeton Ave, Villa Park, IL 60181

hours.notes: Hours come from the structured data on the official Chicago page (Monday–Sunday, 08:00–18:00). Confirm pickup and return windows when you book.

listings.offersNotes: The official Chicago page says one-way rentals are available from Chicago to all active Indie Campers U.S. pickup centers, naming Los Angeles, Nashville, Dallas, Denver, Seattle, and New York; availability and one-way pricing are confirmed at booking. Its FAQ says RVs are pet-friendly if you buy the extra cleaning service, with one pet per motorhome up to 30 kg. The page also advertises unlimited mileage.
listings.visitNotes: The page lists the Princeton Ave address as “Our Pick-up Center” for Indie Campers Chicago.

listings.name: Art’s RV Sales & Service — travel trailer rentals (Glen Ellyn)
listings.area: Glen Ellyn, on North Ave (IL-64) in DuPage County

hours.notes: These are the Art’s RV store hours on the official site, checked November 22, 2026; the site does not publish separate pickup hours for its own trailer rentals. The same footer lists the El Monte rental office at this address as Mon–Fri 9:00 AM–5:00 PM, closed Saturday and Sunday.

listings.offersNotes: The rentals page offers travel trailers with a kitchen package included and says the company can deliver to and set up at your campsite (delivery and setup are quoted by phone). It lists a pet deposit for pets “with approval,” so ask before you book with a pet.
listings.feeNotes: The rentals page lists travel trailers at $440.00 for a weekend (2 nights) and $1,000.00 for a week (7 nights), a $39.95 linen package, a $250.00 security deposit, a $50.00 cleaning deposit, and a $50.00 pet deposit, all as listed on November 22, 2026.
listings.visitNotes: The page says renters and drivers must be at least 25 with a valid driver’s license and credit card. Art’s RV is a dealer that also hosts the El Monte RV Chicago depot at the same address.

listings.name: RV Rent N Go — Cary
listings.area: Cary, in the northwest suburbs (McHenry County)

hours.notes: The official site’s contact block lists “Monday-Sunday: 7am-7pm.” It does not say whether those are office or pickup hours, so confirm your pickup time.

listings.offersNotes: The home page says its RVs are available for pickup or delivery. It lists Class A, B, and C motorhomes and travel trailers, and says some units are rented directly from owners. The pages we checked did not mention one-way trips or pets.
listings.feeNotes: The FAQ lists Coachnet 24/7 roadside assistance at $10/night and outdoor rug rental at $15/trip; its default insurance carries a $1,500 deductible per claim, all as listed on November 22, 2026.
listings.visitNotes: The home page says the company has 32+ RVs available in the Chicago area.
